title: Carry-Forward Absorbed at a Manufacturer Copay Card Period Opening — Savings & Copay Assistance Programs
content:
When a Manufacturer Copay Card of the Savings & Copay Assistance Programs opens a new benefit period, the dollars still standing on the budget account from the period before, the carry-forward, are partly absorbed according to the linked plan, and the absorbed part is taken off the opening credit.

| Linked plan (Prescription Insurance on File) | Part of the carry-forward taken off the credit |
|---|---|
| Commercial High-Deductible Health Plan | a quarter (25 percent), rounded to the cent half up |
| Commercial Copay Plan | half (50 percent), rounded to the cent half up |
| Any other plan | nothing |

The carry-forward is the card's benefit dollars standing before the new period's credit: the credits of its period-opening entries and benefit reversals less its benefit entries and closing entries.

**Hypothetical carry-forward of $367.50.** Commercial High-Deductible Health Plan: $91.88 taken off (a quarter of 367.50 is 91.875, rounded half up). Commercial Copay Plan: $183.75 taken off. Any other plan: nothing.
